hero.title: Digital employees that start right away.
hero.description: Six ready-made solutions for your business, from AI employees to your own app. Each one tailored to you and built into your workflows.

items.title: Voice Agent
items.summary: A phone assistant that answers around the clock, advises and books appointments.
items.what: The Voice Agent answers every call, understands the request, answers questions, books appointments and, if needed, forwards to the right person, day and night and, on request, in several languages.
items.benefit: No more missed calls and no more missed appointments. Your team is freed from routine calls and can focus on what matters.
items.example: A customer calls in the evening wanting an appointment. The agent checks the calendar, books it, sends the confirmation and logs everything in your customer system, in under a minute.

items.title: Chat Agent
items.summary: A chatbot for your website that advises, recommends and answers instantly.
items.what: The Chat Agent greets visitors on your website, answers questions, recommends the right offer, collects contact details and books appointments, instantly, with no waiting.
items.benefit: Website visitors turn into enquiries. Your customers get help right away, and your team no longer answers every standard question by hand.
items.example: A visitor asks about pricing. The Chat Agent explains the packages, recommends the right one and offers an appointment. The lead is qualified before your team even steps in.

items.title: NexAI Calendar
items.summary: An online booking calendar where your customers book themselves and get confirmations and reminders automatically.
items.what: Your customers pick a service and a time on your own booking page and book themselves, via a link on your website, in WhatsApp or on social media. The calendar sends confirmations and reminders by email or SMS, prevents double bookings and installs as an app on your phone.
items.benefit: Fewer phone calls, no double bookings, fewer forgotten appointments. You see your day at a glance and move appointments with a tap, and your customers are informed automatically.
items.example: A customer books a Friday appointment at 10 pm through the link in your WhatsApp profile. She gets the confirmation by SMS right away, a reminder the day before, and the appointment is in your calendar without you doing anything.
features: Confirmations and reminders by email or SMS
Manage services, opening hours and holidays
Works as an app on phone and desktop

items.title: NexAI CRM
items.summary: A customer system where calls, enquiries, appointments and tasks come together automatically.
items.what: NexAI CRM keeps contacts, companies, enquiries and sales opportunities in one place. Calls handled by the voice agent and enquiries from your website land in it automatically, with call transcripts, notes, files and tasks. Reports show you what happened this week. It runs on servers in Germany and is built for data protection.
items.benefit: No sticky notes, no double entry, no forgotten callbacks. Everyone on the team sees at once what was last discussed with a customer and what comes next.
items.example: A prospect calls and the voice agent answers. After the call the contact is in the CRM with the transcript, your team creates the task "send quote" with one click and is reminded automatically.
features: Contacts, companies and enquiries in one place
Calls and website enquiries arrive automatically
Privacy centre, permissions and secure login

items.title: Automation
items.summary: Takes over repetitive tasks and connects your programs with each other.
items.what: We automate repetitive workflows and connect your programs: from email and calendar to your customer system and quotes and invoices. It all runs by itself in the background.
items.benefit: Less copying, fewer mistakes, more time. Tasks that take hours today get done in minutes, reliably and traceably.
items.example: A new form comes in: the customer is created automatically, a confirmation is sent, a quote is generated and everything is filed neatly, without anyone typing a thing.

items.title: NexAI App
items.summary: Your own app for customers or staff, installable on phone and desktop, no app store needed.
items.what: We build you an app in your brand: a customer portal with orders and invoices, a staff app with chat and tasks, or a booking app. It installs straight from the browser on phone and desktop, sends push notifications and runs on servers in Germany.
items.benefit: Your customers and your team have everything in one place, on every device. No app store approval, no waiting for updates, and the app belongs to you.
items.example: A sales partner opens the app on their phone in the morning: new orders, open invoices, a message from the team. They upload a receipt and accounting gets a notification right away.
features: Customer portal, staff app or booking
Installs on iPhone, Android and desktop
In your brand and your colours
